title: Hotfix: default unknown model families to safe kernel set in selector v2
author: Grace Kim
body: Context: During selector v2 canary we saw a rare crash when model-family detection returned UNKNOWN (or empty) and the registry lookup path attempted to resolve a per-family entry without a guard. In the common path we fall back to v1 selection, but in one codepath (override precedence + registry “required” for v2) we were still attempting to dereference an entry for UNKNOWN and hitting an invariant check. This PR makes unknown/partial model metadata safe by defaulting to a conservative kernel set and/or v1 selection depending on config, preventing the crash and keeping selection deterministic. Change summary: 1) Model family detection now normalizes missing/unknown to ModelFamily::Unknown and returns an explicit reason code. 2) Selector v2: if family is Unknown OR no registry entry exists for the resolved family, we short-circuit to a SafeKernelSet selection (prefill/decode) keyed only by GPU capability + seq bucket, and we record selector_fallback_reason=unknown_model_family (instead of raising). 3) Override handling: per-family overrides no longer match Unknown unless explicitly configured (requires allow_unknown_override=true). 4) Telemetry: add a low-cardinality fallback reason enum (unknown_family | missing_registry_entry | invalid_entry | v1_forced) and ensure unknown family is bucketed as "unknown" rather than emitting raw model identifiers. 5) Add regression tests for Unknown family across GPU SKUs and both prefill/decode regimes; add a conformance guard to ensure we never select kernels outside the safe set when family is Unknown. Risk/notes: This is intentionally conservative; Unknown should not silently pick “best guess” kernels that might be numerically risky. Perf impact for Unknown models may be slightly worse but should be stable. This should reduce canary tail events by eliminating crash loops. Test plan: Unit tests: SelectorV2UnknownFamilyFallsBackToSafeSet, OverrideDoesNotApplyToUnknownByDefault, MissingRegistryEntryFallsBackDeterministically. Integration: ran runtime_sim with selector_v2 enabled + synthetic unknown metadata (model_family unset) on L4/A10 shapes; confirmed no crash and kernel_choice is in safe set. Observability: verified trace annotation includes selector_version=v2 and selector_fallback_reason=unknown_model_family and does not include high-cardinality model strings. Rollout: Merge as hotfix; canary owners can re-enable selector_v2 on the same cohort after deploy. Links: Linear ENG-3923 (selector v2 core), ENG-3922 (model family taxonomy). Related: SUP-8874 (sporadic NaNs suspected to correlate with kernel choice; mitigation aligns with safe fallback).
changed_areas: Serving runtime kernel selector v2 (fallback logic), model-family detection normalization, override precedence, selector telemetry labels, unit/integration tests.
commits: kernel-selector: treat unknown family as safe-fallback condition
config: prevent per-family overrides from matching unknown by default
telemetry: add selector_fallback_reason enum + bucket unknown family
tests: add unknown-family + missing-registry entry cases
review_conversation: Hiro Tanaka: Can we confirm this covers both (a) family UNKNOWN and (b) family resolved but registry missing? We had both in prior incidents. Grace Kim (author): Yep—selector now treats either condition as non-fatal and uses SafeKernelSet; added separate tests for Unknown vs MissingRegistryEntry with deterministic behavior + reason code. Noah Patel: Please ensure we don’t accidentally apply an override intended for a real family when family is Unknown. I’d prefer unknown to require an explicit opt-in to override. Grace Kim (author): Done—overrides don’t match Unknown unless allow_unknown_override=true; default false. Added unit test. Yuki Sato: For GPU normalization quirks (MIG/partitioned), does SafeKernelSet key off normalized SKU or SM capability? Grace Kim (author): SafeKernelSet uses the same normalized GPU capability enum as v2 selector (post-normalization). That keeps behavior stable across MIG variants and avoids SKU string matching. Omar El-Sayed: Please include fallback reason in traces and metrics; SRE asked for visibility. Also make sure it doesn’t explode cardinality. Grace Kim (author): Added selector_fallback_reason (enum) and family bucket "unknown". No raw model IDs. Metrics reviewed locally—label set unchanged besides new enum. Hiro Tanaka: Approving if CI is green and perf-smoke passes. Grace Kim (author): CI green; perf-smoke on A10 passed. Merging as squash.
merge_outcome: Merged (squash) into main; intended for inclusion in the next runtime patch build used by canary cohorts.
release_notes: Hotfix: selector v2 no longer crashes when model family metadata is missing/unknown; unknown families now deterministically fall back to a conservative safe kernel set with explicit telemetry on the fallback reason.
